method: Author self-score on the reviewer's rubric: silhouette and proportions 24/30, signature features 23/25, surface detail and material read 13/20, colour and value 12/15, readability at play distance 9/10. Judged from orrery-warden.fidelity-compare.jpg (orthographic EEVEE renders of the low-poly model at the concept's front, side and back angles, framed at the concept's own scale, 2.70 m over the crop height) side by side and in zoomed crops of the chest, core, legs and feet, plus the six in-engine shots in staging/engine, which now render the warden-glow slot through the runtime D11 glow (writeGlowIslands and applyGlowLook from src/enemies/glow.ts). glow-close is the seat camera at the 50 degree lens of docs/verification/p6-glow-orrery-warden.jpg and matched the previous committed still at a mean difference of 1.02/255 before this build. Silhouette: the lower legs are now slim calf lofts under two tapered greave lames with a front ridge, a knee cop and ankle cops, ending in pointed sabatons with three instep lames, a heel cup and a gunmetal sole. The box-palm hands are replaced by lofted gauntlets with a back plate, a knuckle bar, four three-segment fingers with dark joints and a two-segment thumb. The pauldrons are still domes and the orbit band still swings in front of the chest from the side. Signature: the round core disc is replaced by a keyhole (a ring over a tapering slot in a brass frame) with a glow channel running down the abdomen, and the head carries a raised brow plate and gunmetal cheek recesses. Surface: engraved grooves and riveted strips on the pectorals, pauldrons, vambraces and greaves are geometry (the GLB must stay image-free and the brass slot takes the shared set's normal map, so no normal-map bake). They read at compare scale but are subtle at play distance. Colour: the glow keeps the reviewer's measured amber. The brass is unchanged because the slot is replaced at runtime by the shared brass-polished set, so no generator-side lever moves its hue. In the engine glow-close shot the skirt median is (128,100,63) against the concept's (131,93,63): value matches, but the hue is yellower and the highlights go pale.
gaps: The brass hue is unchanged: the front skirt still goes pale gold and the outer ring and back skirt cream under the key lights. The runtime replaces the brass slot with the shared brass-polished set (brass-aged renders paler still), so the fix is a runtime tint or a bronze shared set, outside this generator.
The keyhole core's hot centre stays saturated yellow rather than white-hot. In the EEVEE compare the keyhole reads close to a round disc with a short tail; the shape is clearer in the engine shots.
The pauldrons are still smooth domes with one engraved ring and three rivets, beside the concept's layered pauldrons.
Engraved panel lines and rivets are geometry and read at compare scale, but at play distance they are faint, and the brushed streak texture still looks stretched on the skirt.
Orbit band placement is unchanged: from the side it swings about 0.4 m in front of the chest, where the concept's side view keeps it behind the shoulders.
In the death pose the folded orbit band still intersects the halo rings on the floor.
